model.name: Euro-use area
model.policy: Only manually curated Conquerable Euro land dots are eligible. Explicit classifications, including Unreviewed, take precedence. Unrecorded dots use the pinned worldwide background: land is Foreign and no-land is Water Only. Worldwide land alone never establishes Euro-use eligibility.

provenance.source: Eleven completed filled workbooks; corrected main-cluster v1.1.
provenance.licence: Curated source data: publication licence not yet recorded; preserve provenance.
notes: The outline-only master is retained as a source reference, not used to infer missing filled cells.
Source sea fill is #AAD3DF; earlier handoff described it as #DAE9F8.
Baseline PWA repeats tiles every 360 degrees; 856 dot widths do not equal a full world. Do not modulo-wrap geographic grid indices.

history.comment:
There's Greek land here, but it's just the southermost small unnamed tip of Katonisi (=Kato Nisi), a small, rocky uninhabited islet located just off the coast of the deserted island of Antipsara.

It's also a Special Protection Area (Birds Directive).

https://datazone.birdlife.org/site/factsheet/1151

Greek land here (the Kalogeroi islets), although almost impossible to conquer. Theoretically, a massive private yacht with a seasoned open-sea crew could drop anchor in the vicinity under perfect weather conditions. It's not restricted or protected area.

Land here, near the dot's southern limit: narrow rock tongue off Three Forks Beach
Stora Kölhällen (skerry at 60.0756, 25.6380) + a few reefs and islets, all impossible to visit or even drop an anchor nearby.
Skarvs Skarsgård, Stora Vitkobben, Svenska Björn, and other islands and islets (Sweden)
Princess Elisabeth Island (Belgian artificial energy island under construction).
An Tor island, with Blackrock (Co Mayo) Lighthouse.
No named places other than waterfalls on the Camopi and Tamouri rivers. In the Zone d’Accès Réglementé (ZAR).
In French Guiana, no named places other than waterways in the Zone d’Accès Réglementé (ZAR). Pleiké in Suriname.
